bug_url: internal: shrink ray is_python/libcst C-stack overflow (fixed in this repo)
symptom: Regression evaluation for shrink ray's own deep-nesting robustness. shrink ray probes every input with is_python, which parses it via libcst; libcst's native parser recurses per nesting level and overflowed the C stack (SIGSEGV) on deeply bracket-nested input, crashing shrink ray at startup. This entry is a deeply nested (600-level) Python expression; reducing it must not crash shrink ray and should shrink it to a minimal deeply nested expression. The interestingness test runs the relevant bit of code directly (libcst.parse_module) and requires the file to stay valid Python nested at least 400 levels deep.
